items.title: Zero-Server Architecture
items.desc: Your files never touch our servers. All processing happens locally in your browser's secure sandbox using high-performance WebAssembly.
items.detail: By moving the compute to the client, we eliminate the biggest security risk: data in transit and storage.

items.title: Military-Grade Privacy
items.desc: No tracking pixels, no analytics cookies, and zero data collection. SafeTools is built for anonymity by design.
items.detail: We don't just protect your data; we never see it. Your session is entirely private and non-persistent.

items.title: Sub-Second Latency
items.desc: Experience near-instant processing. Without the need for large file uploads or network round-trips, tools feel like native apps.
items.detail: Process multi-gigabyte files instantly because the data never has to leave your RAM.

items.title: 150+ Specialized Tools
items.desc: A comprehensive suite of utilities for images, PDFs, security, and developmentall in one unified, high-speed workspace.
items.detail: From HEIC conversion to JWT decoding, everything you need is one click away.

items.title: Command Palette (Cmd+K)
items.desc: Navigate the entire platform with lightning speed using our keyboard-driven command interface. Instant access to any tool.
items.detail: Stop clicking through menus. Just hit Cmd+K and type what you need.

items.title: Local Retention System
items.desc: Personalize your workspace with local-first favorites and recently used tools. Your preferences stay on your device.
items.detail: We use encrypted localStorage to remember what you love without ever knowing who you are.
